text:
Ruth Park: Quick UX check — for the RBAC console, how do folks feel about a compact "grants" row per role vs an expanded per-route breakdown? I'm worried compact hides important quota/routing constraints.
Devon: Compact wins for scans. Most customers scan >10 roles, vertical list is noisy. :v:
Aj: Audit teams will ask for per-route info. Maybe show compact, with an expand chevron that loads the per-route telemetry on demand?
Ophelia: +1 to lazy-load expansion. Hover preview could show 3 most-severe routes and a small sparkline for token usage (like per-role cost impact).
Maria: Telemetry note: loading that expansion will hit the telemetry API a lot — we'd want caching + an SLO-friendly circuit breaker. Also, surface whether a route has a routing policy (e.g., cost fallback).
Ruth Park: Good call. UX tradeoff: fast list vs discoverability. What about a lightweight badge: "3 routes" and a small error/warn icon when one of the routes has a special quota or fallback?
Devon: I like the badge. If you click the badge it does the expansion; otherwise it's compact. Keeps initial render fast for big orgs.
Aj: Implementation note: API should return an aggregated grants_summary with counts and top-3 problematic routes so console doesn't need to fetch full list immediately. Example payload: ```{ grants_summary: { route_count: 12, warnings: ["quota_exceeded"], top_routes: [...] } }```
Ophelia: That payload looks good. Also we should include a boolean `has_routing_policy` and `effective_batching_profile` — those affect the UI affordance (e.g., a "costly" flag).
Maria: For rollout: feature-flag the expansion and telemetry calls to avoid SLO regressions. We'll do canary with 10% of tenants, measure p95 increase, and abort if >200ms. deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-04-04 17:00 UTC :robot_face:
Ruth Park: Nice. Action items: Aj to add grants_summary endpoint, Maria to propose caching + circuit breaker, Ophelia to mock badge and hover, Devon to prototype client lazy-load. We'll sync next Thursday. :calendar:
Devon: I'll throw a quick spike tomorrow and post screenshots.
Ophelia: I'll add a tiny microcopy explaining "expand to see per-route quotas and fallbacks" so it's discoverable.
Ruth Park: Thanks team — keeping console usable for large orgs is the goal. :heart:
